title: 第106章：我让你走了吗？

“你居然敢骂张副将！”大力震惊地看向秦昭岚，“我

大力冷哼一声，转身往楼下走。

楼下闹哄哄的，似乎是山匪与官兵吵起来了。

秦昭岚关上房门，便带着苏安安下楼。

刚来到一楼，便看见山匪和张老头等人围在房间外，对着里面骂骂咧咧的。

“发生什么事情了？”秦昭岚上前询问情况。

刘大勇看见她，像是看见了主心骨，快步来到她的面前。

“秦夫人，这些个士兵真不是个东西。他们趁我们搬物资时，霸占了我们的房间！”

“我们才盖好的房子啊，还没来得及住进去，就被他们霸占了。”

张老头叹了一口气，眸子里满是不甘。

秦昭岚皱眉，转头看向身后的一间房。

见房门紧闭，她快步上前，一脚踹开房门。

里面的人正在休息，被动静吓得从地上弹出来。

看见秦昭岚站在门口，士兵不悦地从地上爬起来，拔刀抵在秦昭岚的胸前。

“干什么呢？敢打扰老子休息，信不信老子砍了你？”

秦昭岚冷冷地盯着他。

她快速抬手，在士兵还没反应过来时，一把将刀夺了过来。

士兵手中一空，见自己的刀，架在自己的脖子上，顿时吓得面如死灰。

“你……你把刀还给我！”

“滚！”秦昭岚冷冷地丢下一个字，“否则我杀了你！”

“你……你敢！”

士兵哆嗦着，说话都有些结巴。

秦昭岚向来不喜欢废话，能动手绝不动口。

可这是大家辛辛苦苦盖的房子。

刚盖好就染上血腥，会不吉利。

她不想让大家住在出了人命的房子里，努力控制自己的脾气。

“你可以试试？”

说着，她将刀一横，削断了对方的头发。

士兵吓得双腿一抖，一股温热，从裤裆里流了出来。

秦昭岚皱眉，眼眸里溢满了厌恶。

这个该死的士兵，居然弄脏了他们的房子！

“我再说一次，把你弄脏的地方擦干净，然后滚出去！”

“我……我擦。”

士兵不敢赌，立刻向秦昭岚认怂。

"How dare you scold Vice General Zhang!" Dali looked at Qin Zhaolan in shock, "I

Dali snorted coldly, turned around and walked downstairs.

There was a lot of noise downstairs, as if the bandits were quarreling with the officers and soldiers.

Qin Zhaolan closed the door and took Su Anan downstairs.

As soon as they arrived on the first floor, they saw bandits, Old Man Zhang and others surrounding the room, cursing inside.

"What happened?"Qin Zhaolan stepped forward to ask about the situation.

When Liu Dayong saw her, he seemed to have seen his backbone and quickly came to her.

"Mrs. Qin, these soldiers are really nothing.They occupied our room while we were moving supplies!"

“We just built a house, but before we could move in, it was occupied by them."

Old Man Zhang sighed, his eyes full of unwillingness.

Qin Zhaolan frowned and turned to look at a room behind him.

Seeing that the door was closed, she quickly stepped forward and kicked the door open.

The people inside were resting, and they were so frightened that they jumped out of the ground.

Seeing Qin Zhaolan standing at the door, the soldier got up from the ground unhappily, drew his sword and put it against Qin Zhaolan's chest.

"What are you doing?If you dare to disturb my rest, believe it or not, I will chop you down?"

Qin Zhaolan stared at him coldly.

She quickly raised her hand and snatched the knife away from the soldier before he could react.

The soldier's hands were empty, and when he saw his own knife on his neck, his face turned pale with fear.

"You... give me the knife back!"

"roll!Qin Zhaolan dropped a word coldly, "Otherwise I will kill you!""

"You...you dare!"

The soldier was trembling and stammering when he spoke.

Qin Zhaolan has always disliked nonsense, and would never speak when he could do something.

But this is a house that everyone has worked hard to build.

It will be unlucky if it becomes stained with blood as soon as it is covered.

She didn't want everyone to live in a house where people had died, and tried to control her temper.

"Can you try?"

As she spoke, she swung the knife horizontally and cut off the other person's hair.

The soldier's legs shook in fright, and a warmth flowed out of his crotch.

Qin Zhaolan frowned, her eyes filled with disgust.

This damn soldier actually soiled their house!

“I say it again, wipe up the mess you made and get out!"

"I...I wipe."

The soldiers did not dare to gamble and immediately gave in to Qin Zhaolan.
